We have sent the documents needed for the fiscal year 2026 labor insurance year-end update procedures to administrative delegation business establishments.

When you receive the documents, please open them promptly and check that all contents are included. If any documents are missing, please contact the administrative office.

We appreciate your busy schedules, but we ask that you meet the submission deadline to ensure smooth processing of the year-end update.

Submission deadline: April 22, 2026 (Reiwa 8), Wednesday, by 5:00 PM

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2549/
